name: Quiet neighbors
question: What happens to a glowing crowd when its signal is quenched?
expectedObservationsText: The Glow threshold dish on seed 206. The experiment card copies the dish at a fixed second; copy B receives signal quencher (4 per cell) over the patch. Quencher divides the signal each Lantern senses by (1 + quencher). The comparison reports how many glow in each copy and how many glow-offs each recorded.
